full_resume:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Seasoned engineering leader with over 10 years of experience managing multiple software engineering teams and driving end-to-end delivery excellence. Demonstrated ability to align engineering roadmaps with strategic business objectives, lead architecture reviews to ensure scalable and maintainable solutions, and stabilize delivery operations during critical scale-up phases. Proven expertise in mentoring engineering leads, supporting hiring processes, and standardizing engineering practices to enhance team performance and operational consistency. Skilled at fostering cross-functional collaboration and operational discipline to deliver sustained business impact in dynamic software environments.

LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE

- Directed multiple engineering teams through full software delivery lifecycles, ensuring roadmap priorities aligned with overarching business goals.
- Facilitated architecture reviews to uphold scalable, maintainable, and robust software solutions.
- Supported hiring initiatives to build and grow high-performing engineering teams, contributing to talent acquisition and retention.
- Mentored engineering leads to develop both technical expertise and leadership capabilities, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
- Orchestrated release planning and delivery management to maintain consistent and predictable software releases.
- Implemented process improvements and standardized engineering practices that stabilized delivery operations during critical scale-up periods, reducing operational risks.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Engineering Leadership Roles

- Led cross-functional coordination of engineering roadmaps, ensuring strategic alignment and timely delivery.
- Collaborated with stakeholders to define priorities and resolve architectural challenges, enhancing solution quality and scalability.
- Managed multiple teams and engineering leads, driving performance improvements and operational excellence.
- Championed adoption of best practices in software development and delivery, improving code quality and release reliability.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Technical Skills:
- Java, Python, Cloud Technologies, Architecture Review, AWS

Leadership & Management:
- Leadership, Stakeholder Management, Mentoring, Delivery Management, Planning, Hiring Support

Tools & Software:
- Jira, Confluence

PROJECTS

Sample Platform Modernization and Engineering Process Standardization Initiatives

- Led modernization of legacy platform architecture to improve scalability and maintainability, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.
- Standardized engineering processes across teams, introducing best practices that enhanced development efficiency, code quality, and release reliability.
- Delivered enhanced platform scalability and operational consistency, supporting long-term business growth and improved engineering productivity.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Computer Science
